summary.en: A famous magician hires Kogoro to keep watch on his staff members, as he believes one of them may be out to kill him. For his first act, he lies on a bed of spikes, and is slammed with another, which has Kogoro and Conan worried until he's revealed to be alive. The next trick does not go so well, and he ends up trapped in a water tank where the entrance has been sealed. By the time it's open and he's rescued, it's too late, and one of his workers is responsible. In the water tank escape show, Fuyuki prepares to escape from the tank, but drowns after he fails to open the upper part of the cage.
summary.zhHans: 围绕水无怜奈、CIA、FBI和组织行动展开的长期情报战。
